source_independence: Source IDs come from filename prefixes. Registry asserts source separation, not participant separation. Raw video bytes, unique people and clinical diagnoses are not independently authenticated by this audit.

bootstrap.method: Paired class-stratified source bootstrap; each sampled occurrence carries total source weight one; percentile interval.
bootstrap.qualification: Retrospective descriptive sensitivity intervals conditional on fixed OOF predictions, models, split and class source counts. Assumes source clusters independent, although participant independence is unknown and training sets overlap. No retraining, model selection, split or seed uncertainty; not a confirmatory population confidence interval or an equivalence test.

source_plurality.qualification: Exploratory hard-label plurality aggregation. Saved OOF rows contain no probabilities, so calibrated or averaged probability aggregation cannot be recovered from those rows alone. The range is sensitivity to all possible tie decisions, not a confidence interval. Fixed label-order tie resolution is arbitrary and should not become a headline result.

run_comparison.interpretation: Both executions report computed folds and have different checkpoint/embedding bytes and numerically different embedding arrays, with identical S-JEPA hard predictions. Their registry, data, seed and split are the same. This is repeat execution, not independent seed or cohort replication; direct cache reuse is not demonstrated.

rf_verification.interpretation: Current feature extraction reproduces all 88 latest RF predictions. Replacing only left_ankle_range with right_ankle_range reproduces all 88 historical RF predictions. Thus the historical versus current RF difference is reproducible from this one feature correction with the saved split and RF settings. This audit does not modify production features or train neural models.

metric_definition: Source-weighted metrics pool clip confusion contributions with clip weight 1 / usable clips in its source. They retain clip decisions and are not one classification per source. Fold standard deviations use ddof=0 and are descriptive, not standard errors.
historical_scope: The g1/R1 cache has 47 clips and a different registry, training budget, and readout; its 0.4384 S-JEPA and 0.6666 RF scores cannot be merged with the 88-clip full-v1 evaluation.
source_hierarchy: The top-level notebook 06 prose reports the September 21 retained full-v1 run, including the duplicated-ankle RF; its seven code cells have no execution outputs. Use notebook_primary_metrics for the notebook-anchored manuscript and corrected_verification_metrics only as explicitly labeled reanalysis. The initial audit's primary_metrics key is retained for compatibility and refers to the corrected latest execution.

single_clip_counterfactual_search.qualification: A unique single-label counterfactual reproduces the draft's complete rounded S-JEPA numerical signature and its RF/bootstrap values. This is forensic consistency evidence, not an observed experiment or proof of how the discrepancy arose. Both saved run files instead record ms for this clip; no artifact was edited and synthetic rows were never exported as data.

root_causes: S-JEPA draft results are inconsistent with both retained OOF runs. A single unsupported ms-to-pd change on -oJM2wUUjws_P1_02 reconstructs all examined rounded S-JEPA results, including abstract, table, per-class values, fold spread and individual/RF bootstrap intervals.

The identical RF and mean-pose paired intervals are erroneous. Even for the counterfactual rows explaining the draft numbers, mean-pose gives [-0.1478957, 0.1845686], whereas RF gives [-0.1209356, 0.2309749]. Equality is consistent with a copied or misassigned interval, but the editing history is unavailable.

RF results in the draft describe the historical duplicated-ankle feature implementation. The corrected current implementation produces 12 different predictions and a lower score; all old and new RF predictions were independently reproduced by a one-column feature change.
Dataset composition, mean-pose/visibility/majority rows, mean-pose superiority in four folds, and the distinction between pooled metrics and fold spread agree with retained artifacts.
